title: Raw garlic for insane pumps & a stronger immune system
summary: NH explains why he eats raw garlic daily: it's believed to boost immunity (though not a coronavirus cure), and in his experience it improves pumps and vascularity. He covers downsides (breath and body odour, blood thinning at very high doses), dosage (start with one clove, ramp up, 3-6 cloves/day, never more than half a bulb), crushing or slicing it so it releases its compounds, and buying organic.

claims.claim: Garlic has long been used in traditional medicine for immunity, before science backed it.
Raw garlic is better than cooked because heat destroys some nutrients; cooking only makes it milder.
He hasn't been sick in 10 years, since he started working out at 15.
Exercise already boosts immunity, so adding raw garlic is a double benefit.
Raw garlic will not protect you from catching or cure coronavirus; it may only support general immunity.
Eating a lot of raw garlic at lunch gives him a very high-quality pump when training 4-5 hours later.
Tolerance builds: 1-1.5 months ago three cloves gave insane pumps, now three cloves do nothing.
Garlic is said to improve cholesterol, reduce blood pressure and help prevent some diseases with regular consumption.
Very high doses can thin the blood and cause dizziness, but you need to eat a lot to get there.
The main downside is that breath and sweat smell of garlic; brush and shower. The smell was worst at first and decreased as his body adapted.
Start with one clove for a week and then add one, rather than five or six at once.
He eats raw garlic twice a day every day during the crisis, 3-6 cloves daily as a heavy person; more than half a bulb a day is overkill.
You must cut or crush garlic so it contacts oxygen and releases its beneficial compounds; don't swallow it whole like a pill.
His method: peel and slice the garlic very thin and place it on warm food so it goes down easily; the burn fades with habituation.
Bro-science: garlic seems to have increased his vascularity (a vein on his right shoulder, veins on his hips) without fat loss, making him look leaner.
Garlic may aid recovery and longevity by making you more resilient to disease.
Buy organic raw garlic from a good origin; it's cheap and a bag lasts months, so get top quality.
